text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Noble, lovely, strong! 
Gorgeous, graceful, courageous!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is princess I strive to be——truly stalwart princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deeeryaaaaaaa—————!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa……! Kawakami-san's running looks so powerful every time……
I can almost hear heavy footsteps from here～……

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
That powerhouse stride gives her overwhelming finishing burst. 
Five consecutive wins so far, including two G1s——

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Three straight wins from debut straight into 『Japanese Oaks』……
You remember how she took it, right?

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally unforgettable……! Raw physical power 
and sheer guts……Kawakami-san was unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Just like Double Tiara in 『Shuka Sho』. 
Thought it'd be three-way showdown beforehand, but——

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Article called it 『one-sided domination in the end』. 
Pace was crazy fast, turning whole race into marathon sprint.

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Her immense power allowed display of high-level endurance. 
That is Kawakami's true weapon.

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Her top spot in Tiara generation looks set in stone now. 
Feels that way anyway～……! Kawakami-san is incredible……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew———……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
……Mmm. 
One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! She's so stoic～……! 
Next 『Queen Elizabeth II Cup』 is basically hers, right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Absolutely! I will take victory! 
Spectacular win that blows everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ……Now is moment. As true princess, I'll deliver!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
——Thank you for your time, Kawakami Princess-san! 
Clear you are fired up for 『Queen Elizabeth II Cup』!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Expectations for Kawakami-san are sky-high, everyone is thrilled……
This will make fantastic article.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much♪ 
Please build up excitement as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Will do! ……Especially given recent gloomy mood 
surrounding Tiara line after that unfortunate news.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ……Yes. Honestly, it was huge shock to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san told me so much about her. 
To Team <Ascella>, she was like radiant sun……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And to me too. News about last year's Unorthodox Double Tiara winner……
Every Tiara Uma Musume felt deep pain in heart……!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: For someone like her to end up in such state……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ——However, that is precisely why!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Princess I aim to be never gives up searching for light, 
even in deepest darkness, right until very end!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will shine brightly and blast gloom away! 
I will lift everyone's spirits with my own hands!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-san……! 
Yes, absolutely! I'll be rooting for you……!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (That's right……! I will do it, without fail!)

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
——Alright, intra-team mock race starts now! 
Everyone take positions. Ready……Go!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I must win! Definitely——definitely!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Final straight……Now's the time——!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Nuuuuuuugaaaaaaaa-!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ! Hey, wait——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Puhaa……! Haa, haa……!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text: Eh? Uh, first place is Kawakami Princess-san……?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ……Hold on. Kawakami, your course cut was way too reckless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
In real race, you'd get penalized for obstruction, you know? 
……Actually, lately you've been——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so terribly sorry! 
Unforgivable blunder……Forgive me, City-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Such reckless behavior totally unbefitting……!
Will re-drill basics at once! Nuoooooo———!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Aaargh……damn it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself way too hard lately……Hope she's fine. 
Need better way to check on her——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Keep training momentum going today～～～! 
Muscle training time, sweat and grind——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh my～ what terrible trouble～! I am in such distress～!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san! You seem distressed……
Whatever is matter?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh～ Kawakami-san, immaculate timing! 
What fortuitous coincidence!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You see, need this cardboard box moved to training grounds. 
However, right now, just slight twinge～……er……strained my hip.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how awful! Leave mere cardboard box to me! 
Can lift this with pinky finger alone!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then I shall leave it in your capable hands. 
……Pardon me. Thank you, Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……Right around here is fine. 
Could you set it down there, Kawakami-san?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Hup-to! 
……Well then, I shall take my——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaaaaaaaaaaahh……!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ! That voice just now——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huu, huu, huu, huu…… 
Taaaaaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(……? W-what is this? 
Pandora-san——!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Hold form, hold, hold……!
Uraaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa————!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(That flexibility……length of that final burst, sheer speed! 
Her stride, expression, aura——)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Completely transformed from before……?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Listen closely, Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is……well, not advice. 
More of 『complaint』. So I'll state it plainly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……You act like you're only one 
shouldering entire burden of winning.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
——In first place, nobody asked you 
to carry everything alone, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do not underestimate kouhais on our team.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaaa……! 
Haa, haa, haa——……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……I will win. I will definitely win——!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ………… How foolish of me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my insolence, King-san. 
I was being slightly……no, terribly conceited.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will engrave this onto my heart. 
In upcoming 『Queen Elizabeth II Cup』, my greatest rival——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Her name is Fusaichi Pandora!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……Fufu, seems lesson was received loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally! Fully understood!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
……By way, King-san. 
Please treat your hip with care.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ……Ah, yes～! My hip. Ah, right, hip! 
Naturally, will take utmost care! Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu! Please do! 
King-san, always stay full of vigor.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Always——to me, you are irreplaceable guide leading way.
